content_value: Between Biaxial and Uniaxial Geogrid and Cellular Confinement Technologies, Geosynthetics Have Been at the Forefront of Soil Stabilization Applications Since 1959.

• Renewable Energy Sites
  • Power Line Utility Access
  • Haul Roads
  • Industrial Sites
  • Laydown Yards

BaseLok® Geogrids high-strength, high-stiffness geogrids provide superior soil stabilization and aggregate reinforcement over weak subgrades. Their engineered rib profiles improve aggregate interlock, lateral restraint, and load distribution, increasing effective bearing capacity while reducing rutting and surface deformation. These geosynthetic solutions improve performance and durability for roads, working platforms, and heavy-load applications.

BaseLok<sup>®</sup> GeoCell provides advanced soil stabilization and load support for weak subgrades and heavy-load applications. Its cellular confinement system accommodates sand, recycled materials, and aggregate infill while improving lateral restraint and load distribution. Combined with BaseLok<sup>®</sup> geogrids or FabGrid<sup>®</sup>, the Foundation Performance System (FPS) delivers enhanced reinforcement for challenging soil conditions.

Weak subgrades and heavy equipment loads create significant challenges for aggregate roads, industrial laydown yards, and temporary working platforms. Poor soil bearing capacity and inadequate aggregate stabilization can cause excessive rutting, surface deformation, and premature failure, increasing maintenance costs, disrupting construction schedules, and limiting site access.
